five_minute_playtest.precondition: Extract the entire repaired e034 ZIP into a new writable directory and allow first import before the five-minute play period. Keep receipt hold unchecked and receipt work at the default4ms soft budget. Check sourcee034f229 in the delivered manifest.

steps.action: Run Verify ObjectShard Lab.cmd, then Open ObjectShard M3 Preflight.cmd without arguments. Wait for Native material ready. Open Configuration briefly; confirm seed12 and4ms soft budget, then collapse it.
steps.pass: Verifier succeeds and the ordinary playable A scene appears paused, with material and controls.
steps.fail: Hash mismatch, native/import error, blank scene, auto-exit into probe receipt, or wrong source.

steps.action: Click Resume. Left-drag Erase through the lower Wood support, or use Cut lower support. While the crown falls, paint a short Sand or Water stroke in empty World space; right-click a moving cell to inspect.
steps.pass: World clock advances; structure transfers once, falls and collides; edits enter the retained queue and apply or show explicit refusal; moving inspection identifies ObjectShard.
steps.fail: Floating main structure despite a complete accepted cut and free capacity, duplicate image/owner, invisible collision, silent edit loss, unexplained Held/fault, or stopped advertised progression.

steps.action: Try a fresh one-cell Erase on moving Wood; retry a TargetChanged refusal with a fresh stroke. Wait for the body to sleep naturally, then click Erode resting cell and continue observing.
steps.pass: Accepted cut removes real owned material; geometry stays associated with the body. After natural sleep and erosion there is no violent late rotation.
steps.fail: Fresh accepted cut damages a different owner/cell, ghost geometry, unexplained inventory loss, violent late twitch or inconsistent hold.
steps.qualification: A TargetChanged refusal is a safe stale witness result. If natural sleep has not occurred within this time allocation, extend observation and mark settling not yet established; do not force sleep.

steps.action: Pause and let pending operations drain; Single step, then Resume. Export once while running. Reset, wait for the fresh paused scene, then select J · Sustained external flame and Resume for visible Fire/Smoke; return to A if desired.
steps.pass: Single step advances one requested interval after pending completion; export opens files without pausing; reset/scenario change cleanly replaces the session; J creates genuine visible external Fire.
steps.fail: Old moving bodies survive reset, controls stop responding, export claims success without files, or changed scenario retains stale owners.

steps.action: Pause and let queues drain, then Export bug report. Press F2 and wait for the launcher; re-enter ObjectShard M3 Preflight and confirm a fresh paused A scene. Close the window normally. Relaunch M3 once, then close it and use Open ObjectShard Lab.cmd to check the preserved control.
steps.pass: Incident and corresponding JSONL exist with the delivered source identity. F2 retains the scene until disposal, then reaches the real launcher; re-entry has no previous bodies. Normal window close terminates, relaunch is fresh, and old Lab opens independently.
steps.fail: Silent lost edits, old bodies/worker surviving navigation, wrong source, missing files without an explicit reason, blank/stuck handoff, unintended new owner after Reset was cancelled, or failed close/relaunch.
steps.qualification: If explicit ShutdownHeld occurs, retain/export the evidence and retry F2 or window close; do not call it a pass merely because the screen is retained. Physical target-machine acceptance remains the owner decision.

findings.disposition: Async F2 hook waits for native disposal, thread join and main-thread RID release; restores the previous quit policy and fences deferred completion identity.
Support/Erode buttons and central pointer-intent admission refuse new play input during closing/replacement/held states.
Process-exit priority survives shutdown hold and F2 retry. Explicit Reset starts a new exit intent scope.
